sentences.english: Do you go to KTVs and ballrooms?
Tanaka and I haven't been either.

sentences.chinese: 以后我请你们一起去唱歌和跳舞，怎么样？
sentences.english: Later I'll treat you all to go singing and dancing together, how about that?

sentences.chinese: 今天晚上咱们去唱歌，怎么样？
sentences.english: How about we go singing tonight?

sentences.chinese: 我以前只听说过"明月"KTV，没听说过"新月"KTV。
sentences.english: I'd only heard of Mingyue KTV before; I'd never heard of Xinyue KTV.

sentences.chinese: "新月"歌厅是新开的。我去过几次，还不错。
sentences.english: Xinyue KTV is newly opened. I've been a few times; it's pretty good.
Okay, then let's go to Xinyue KTV.
Have you ever been to Xingyue Ballroom?

sentences.chinese: 去过，还不错。今天晚上咱们去那儿跳舞怎么样？
sentences.english: Yes, I have; it's pretty good. How about we go dancing there tonight?

sentences.chinese: 好啊！咱们打车去还是骑自行车去？
sentences.english: Sure! Should we take a taxi or ride bikes there?

sentences.chinese: 不用打车，也不用骑车。"星月"舞厅很近，就在学校旁边。
sentences.english: No need for a taxi or a bike. Xingyue Ballroom is close, right next to the school.

sentences.chinese: 我以前来过这儿，这是我第二次来。
sentences.english: I've been here before; this is my second time.

sentences.chinese: 这个字我不认识，我们没学过。
sentences.english: I don't recognize this character; we haven't studied it.
I've never been to Beijing, and I really want to go.

vocab.english: here used after verbs to connect a complement

sentences.english: There will be a test tomorrow.
There will be a test tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 王老师，我们什么时候考试？
sentences.english: Teacher Wang, when do we have the exam?
Is the test on reading and writing, or on listening and speaking?

sentences.chinese: 我们已经学了多少汉字？
sentences.english: How many Chinese characters have we already learned?
Will all of them be tested?
All of them will be tested.
What do you think of Chinese?

sentences.chinese: 汉语发音不难，汉字很难。
sentences.english: Chinese pronunciation isn't difficult, but the characters are very hard.
But Chinese characters are very interesting.

sentences.chinese: 我觉得汉字很容易，发音和语法比较难。
sentences.english: I think the characters are easy; the pronunciation and grammar are harder.

sentences.chinese: 发音、语法都不难，问题是汉字和词语。
sentences.english: Pronunciation and grammar aren't hard; the problem is the characters and vocabulary.

sentences.chinese: 汉字太难，写不好；词语太多，记不住。
sentences.english: The characters are too hard to write well, and there are too many words to memorize.

sentences.chinese: 现在你们觉得自己的汉语怎么样？
sentences.english: Now, how do you feel about your own Chinese?

sentences.chinese: 你以前学过，当然进步很快。
sentences.english: You studied it before, so of course you make fast progress.

sentences.chinese: 我听说不行，只能说一点儿。
sentences.english: My listening and speaking aren't good; I can only say a little.

sentences.chinese: 我进步比较慢，因为我以前没学过。
sentences.english: I make progress rather slowly, because I didn't study it before.

sentences.chinese: 我看，不是因为你没学过，是因为你不太努力。
sentences.english: In my opinion, it's not because you didn't study before; it's because you don't try hard enough.

sentences.chinese: 王老师，下星期一的考试难不难？
sentences.english: Teacher Wang, is next Monday's exam difficult?

sentences.chinese: 我们班每一个同学都能通过吗？
sentences.english: Can every student in our class pass?

sentences.chinese: 如果努力学习，一定能通过。
sentences.english: If you study hard, you'll definitely pass.
Teacher Wang, what time does the exam start?

sentences.chinese: 八点半开始。大家别迟到。
sentences.english: It starts at eight thirty. Everyone, don't be late.
How long does the exam last?
We have exams tomorrow and the day after tomorrow.

sentences.chinese: 明天考读写，后天考听说。
sentences.english: Tomorrow is the reading-and-writing test; the day after is the listening-and-speaking test.

sentences.chinese: 今天晚上我要好好儿复习。
sentences.english: Tonight I'm going to review carefully.
